name: university
description: University — scripts de vérification communs. Pas de workspaces : backend/ et frontend/ gardent chacun leur bun.lock.

scripts.install:all: cd backend && bun install && cd ../frontend && bun install
scripts.typecheck: cd backend && bun run typecheck && cd ../frontend && bun run typecheck
scripts.test: cd backend && bun run test && cd ../frontend && bun run test:unit
scripts.lint: cd backend && bun run lint && cd ../frontend && bun run lint
scripts.format:check: cd backend && bun run format:check; cd ../frontend && bun run format:check
